step1_analysis.description: Generates a bias voltage (VBN) from a control voltage (VBP) using a PMOS current source and a diode-connected NMOS. Dummy transistors (XM3, XM4) act as decoupling capacitors to filter noise, which aligns with the paper's focus on phase noise suppression.

paper_reference.title: Techniques for Phase Noise Suppression in Recirculating DLLs

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using the square law model with SKY130 parameters.

I_bias.description: Bias current generated by the PMOS

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on exact Vth and mobility of the PMOS device.

AC_Gain.description: Small-signal gain from VBP to VBN

sky130_expected.reasoning: Ratio of transconductances of PMOS and NMOS.

step3_testbench.description: Measures DC operating point (VBN, current, power) and AC gain from VBP to VBN.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Bias Circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 VBN VBN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VBN VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VBN GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VBN VDD VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBP VBP 0 dc 0.99 ac 1

.control
  op
  let vbn_dc = v(VBN)
  let i_bias = -i(VVDD)
  let power = i_bias * 1.8
  print vbn_dc i_bias power

  ac dec 10 1 1G
  let gain_db = vdb(VBN)
  meas ac low_freq_gain find gain_db at=100
  
  quit
.endc
.end
